name: 74403 · Muskogee, OK
findings: ZIP 74403 (Muskogee) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74403 (Muskogee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74403 (Muskogee) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
